metadata.title: Arundhati Pipeline v2.2.0
metadata.subtitle: Local-First Scale & Hardening · 12 tasks · Phase II (amended)
metadata.amendment: 2026-07-20: Tasks 6, 7, 18 (containers/Helm/K8s) permanently removed per user directive; scope realigned to CLAUDE_START_HERE.md local-first mandate. Task 8 now depends on task 1.

tasks.label: AMP Governance
tasks.description: Resolve open AMPs and ADR decisions from Phase I before Phase II begins

tasks.label: Observability & SRE (Local-First)
tasks.description: Phase II.2: Prometheus metrics, local Grafana dashboard configs, alert rules, OpenTelemetry tracing, structured logging with correlation IDs, SLI/SLO definitions — all runnable on the local machine, no Helm/K8s

tasks.label: Architecture Review: Observability
tasks.description: Phase II.2: ADRs for observability stack, log retention policy, trace propagation, incident runbooks

tasks.label: SDK Public Release & Developer Experience
tasks.description: Phase II.3: Python SDK to PyPI, TypeScript SDK to npm, auto-generated API docs, Jupyter notebooks, versioning policy

tasks.label: Worker Pools & Batch Scaling (Local-First)
tasks.description: Phase II.4: Worker pools (CPU/I/O/AI), queue-depth-based local worker scaling, task monitoring UI, batch job API (1000+ records) — no K8s HPA

tasks.label: Architecture Review: Worker Topology
tasks.description: Phase II.4: ADRs for worker pool topology, message broker choice, retry policies, task priority routing

tasks.label: AI Model Hardening & Calculator Integration
tasks.description: Phase II.5: LLM-as-Judge yoga scoring, deterministic chart comparison, hypothesis grounding in Knowledge Graph, AI fallback to rule-based, gold-standard validation

tasks.label: Documentation & Developer Tools
tasks.description: Phase II.6: Developer onboarding guide, IDE configs, pre-commit hooks, changelog, migration guide v2.1→v2.2, deprecation policy

tasks.label: Quality Gate: Full Test Suite
tasks.description: Per-phase QA: local-first output parity, performance SLOs, security scans, regression suite

tasks.label: Governance: Compliance Audit
tasks.description: Phase II governance: local-first compliance, SDK API stability, AI model transparency

tasks.label: Release: v2.2.0 Tag, Changelog, Notes
tasks.description: v2.2.0 Release: Git tag, PyPI + npm publish readiness, release notes, migration guide — no Helm/OCI/container registry

tasks.label: Benchmark: AI Accuracy Gold Standard
tasks.description: Phase II.5 Benchmark: Gold-standard yoga dataset, AI agreement rate > 90%, A/B testing vs domain experts, adversarial edge-case testing

removed_tasks.note: Removed 2026-07-20 per user directive — out of scope under CLAUDE_START_HERE.md local-first mandate (no Docker/K8s/Helm/cloud). Do not re-add without an explicit Architecture Office ADR and a decision recorded in ASTROOS_V2_STATUS.md.
